hints.title: Restricted Set Pruning
hints.text: Nodes in the restricted list cannot be visited and effectively block traversal across their incident edges.

hints.title: Filtered Adjacency Traversal
hints.text: Perform a breadth-first or depth-first search starting at node 0, advancing only to neighbors not in the restricted set.

hints.title: Connected Component Size
hints.text: Count the total number of reachable nodes visited from node 0.

hints.title: Filtered Graph Traversal Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: BFS visits each allowable node and edge once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking full paths repeatedly for restricted nodes costs quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Restricted set and queue store at most n nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Filters edges using restricted set and explores connected component from root 0.
